newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Bancorp to buy Wells Fargo branch.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Bancorp to buy Wells Fargo branch.

text.p: Coastal Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it has executed a definitive agreement to purchase the Wells Fargo Bank branch located at 441 Austin Avenue in Port Arthur, Texas.
The purchase includes deposits of approximately $74 million, the facility, its furniture, fixtures and other fixed assets.
Consummation of the proposed sale, which the company said is expected in the third quarter, is subject to regulatory approval and other customary closing conditions.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
At December 31, Coastal had total assets of about $2.9 billion and deposits of about $1.3 billion.
